story_type: bomber takeoff and landing in bad weather
hook: Two B-52 bombers climbed off a soaked runway into Alaska cloud.
narration: Two B-52 bombers roared off a soaked Alaska runway, straight into the clouds.
They came from Minot Air Force Base in North Dakota, with the sixty-ninth Bomb Squadron.
On July sixteenth, 2023, they rolled out at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson for a bomber exercise.
The runway was wet, and the takeoff roll threw spray across the field.
Each B-52 has eight jet engines, and at full power they pour out dark smoke.
The bombers climbed toward the mountains and vanished into the low cloud.
The next day they came back down through the same gray sky.
A landing B-52 opens a drag chute behind its tail to help slow its huge weight.
outcome: Both B-52s returned to Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson on July seventeenth.
title: B-52s take off into Alaska cloud
description:
Two B-52H Stratofortresses from Minot Air Force Base take off from a rain-soaked runway at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson, Alaska, on July 16, 2023, and return the next day.
